answer: Each agent must compute a sequential memory-hard proof bound to its unique local working set, refreshed only by a private zephyr of beacon-derived challenges that cannot be precomputed in parallel. Attestations pass through a capacity-limited inlet of cross-cluster peers whose total weight is capped by min-cut; splitting into n clones forces n separate quill state machines and n times the inlet bandwidth, so farm cost grows linearly with headcount rather than being amortized.
